g.text: Retrieve and consume the matching ledger entry
Validate all requested lookup tuples exist; pop entries; decrement outstanding[pair].
Return the same bytes to the slave. A does not increase on retrieval.
A second retrieval of a consumed ID raises UnknownKeyID.

g.text: Pool quota: limits issued-but-unretrieved keys for master->slave; 0 disables it.
Protocol quota: limits requests in a rolling 1-second history (plate 4).
Outstanding state survives issuance until retrieval; simulated sweeps issue without retrieving and

g.text: This is a software supply model, not a quantum link or measured

FIGURE 3. The pool is a rate-limited key-credit model with random bytes created at issue time. The available count is bounded; the outstanding ledger is not bounded when its quota is disabled. All pool mutations use one mutex.
Sources: qkd_mock/{pool,server,client,models}.py; settings.py. API family reference: ETSI GS QKD 014 V1.1.1 [R2].
